name: Coddle
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 250 g bacon, chopped into 3 cm pieces

steps: Completely submerge bacon, onions, and sausages in broth, then boil for about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, cutting into bite-sized pieces if necessary, then add the rest of the stock.
Return to the boil and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes have started to disintegrate, thickening the broth.
Add salt and pepper to serve.

culture.text: Coddle is an Irish dish which is often made to use up leftovers. It most commonly consists of layers of roughly sliced pork sausages and rashers with chunky potatoes, sliced onion, salt, pepper, and herbs. Traditionally, it can also include barley.
